channel.title: Paksh: Economy
channel.description: Paksh maps how India's media covers every story — coverage, gaps, and how it develops, in English and Hindi.

item.title: US Consumer Sentiment Near Record Low
item.description: US consumer sentiment has fallen to near a record low, driven by widespread frustration with the economy. A survey indicated this decline, reflecting growing public dissatisfaction. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Truckers Warn of Domino Effect from Soaring Diesel Costs
item.description: American truckers have issued a warning that rising diesel prices could trigger a 'domino effect.' This warning comes amid concerns about the impact of these costs, with one report also linking the issue to rising sea levels. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Boots Sold to Canadian Billionaire Family
item.description: Boots, a long-standing British high street retailer, has been sold to a Canadian billionaire family. The sale raises questions about potential impacts on consumers. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Americans 75+ Identified as Wealthiest Age Group by Fed Survey
item.description: A survey conducted by the U.S. Federal Reserve has identified Americans aged 75 and older as the wealthiest age group. This finding indicates a significant concentration of wealth within this demographic. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: China to Regulate Tech Sector, Manage AI Risks
item.description: China has announced its intention to curb speculative bubbles within its technology sector and to manage the risks associated with artificial intelligence. The government aims to implement measures to control the growth of tech companies… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: US Treasury yields rise, fueling global inflation fears
item.description: US 10-year Treasury yields have approached 5.4%, a level not seen since 2002, while Brent crude oil remains above $100 per barrel. These factors are contributing to global inflation concerns. French government bond yields are also nearing… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: US Secures Diesel Deal with Russia Amid Energy Inflation
item.description: The United States has reached an agreement with Russia for the immediate supply of over 300,000 tons of diesel fuel. This deal comes as the U.S. has experienced elevated energy inflation throughout 2026. Experts, however, express… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: SEBI to issue new derivatives settlement guidelines within a week
item.description: SEBI chairman Tuhin Kanta Pandey said the regulator expects to publish guidelines on the settlement-price mechanism for derivatives on expiry days during the closing auction session within a week, after reviewing the Closing Auction… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Government to Finalize Critical Minerals Stockpile Policy in a Month
item.description: The Indian government is expected to finalize a policy for stockpiling critical minerals within the next month. This policy aims to secure reserves of these essential resources. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Indian Rupee Fluctuates Against US Dollar
item.description: The Indian Rupee experienced fluctuations against the US Dollar, reaching a five-month low of 96.7 according to one report, while another stated it rose 16 paise to close at 96.72. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Walmart Canada Offers Deals on Various Products
item.description: Walmart Canada is holding a "Deal Days" event, offering discounts on a range of products. News outlets are highlighting specific deals available during this promotion. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Cochin Shipyard Secures Repeat Order for Luxury Vessels
item.description: Cochin Shipyard has received a repeat order to build two luxury cruise vessels, with the contract valued between Rs 100 crore and Rs 250 crore. Following this announcement, shares of Cochin Shipyard saw a 5% increase. The company also has… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.title: Netflix Reportedly Planning Significant Workforce Reductions
item.description: Netflix is reportedly planning to lay off approximately 5% of its workforce, with some reports indicating the cuts could occur as early as next week. The streaming giant is pursuing new revenue streams, including expansion into live… Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.title: Online Calculators Help Plan Loan Repayments
item.description: Online EMI calculators are available for various loan types, including car loans and personal loans, to help individuals plan their repayment schedules. These tools allow users to calculate their Equated Monthly Installments (EMIs) online… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 2.

item.title: Akasa Air launches flights connecting Jaipur to Mumbai and Bengaluru
item.description: Akasa Air has launched direct flights connecting Jaipur, Rajasthan, with Mumbai and Bengaluru. The airline will also commence operations from Udaipur on October 15, as part of its expansion plans in the state. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Noida Authority Approves Sports City Master Plan
item.description: The Noida Authority has approved a revised master layout plan for a Sports City project in Sector 150. Residential development is set to comprise 29.5 percent of the project's area. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: TCS Reports Slowest Q2 Growth in Three Years Amidst Muted Demand
item.description: Tata Consultancy Services (TCS) reported its slowest second-quarter revenue growth in three years, with a 0.2% sequential increase in the July-September period. This growth, however, exceeded analyst expectations. The company noted… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 5 · Right 0.

item.title: Gold and Silver Prices Rise on October 9
item.description: On October 9, the prices of gold and silver saw an increase. The latest rates for gold were reported in Delhi, Uttar Pradesh, and Bihar. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 1.

item.title: Foreign currency deposits may impact bank margins
item.description: Inflows from Foreign Currency Non-Resident (Bank) or FCNR(B) deposits are anticipated to put pressure on the profit margins of banks. Additionally, capital goods companies are facing challenges due to a slowdown in order inflows during the… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 6 · Right 0.

item.title: EU and China agree to limit hybrid car exports
item.description: The European Union and China have reached an understanding to reduce China's hybrid car exports to the EU. Brussels stated that Beijing's shipments could fall by more than half over four years, potentially cutting millions of vehicles… Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 9 · Right 0.

item.title: Tesla Renames 'Full Self-Driving' to 'Assisted Driving' in Europe
item.description: Tesla has renamed its 'Full Self-Driving' software to 'Assisted Driving' in Europe as the company seeks regulatory clearance for the technology. The change in branding aims to comply with European regulations and facilitate the software's… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Warner Bros. Discovery CEO Zaslav Receives $606 Million Payout
item.description: David Zaslav, the outgoing CEO of Warner Bros. Discovery, is set to receive a payout of $606 million following the company's takeover by Paramount. This compensation includes $381.7 million in stock options. Zaslav reportedly sold nearly… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: AI Companies Scramble for Computing Power and Talent in Silicon Valley
item.description: In Silicon Valley, artificial intelligence companies are aggressively seeking both computing power and skilled talent, leading to significant shifts in the tech landscape. AI firms are reportedly poaching employees from established tech… Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: New Snapdragon Chip to Power Flagship Phones from iQOO, Motorola, Xiaomi
item.description: Qualcomm's Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6 chip is set to power three upcoming flagship smartphones from iQOO, Motorola, and Xiaomi. The iQOO 16 has been confirmed to launch in India featuring this new chip. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: NCC Secures ₹1,286 Crore Road Project Order in Telangana
item.description: NCC has secured a road project order worth ₹1,286 crore in Telangana. Following this announcement, shares of NCC rose by 5%, while shares of KEC International also surged up to 6% due to fresh order wins. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Tupperware Launches Diwali Celebration Glassware Exclusively on Instamart
item.description: Tupperware, a brand described as the original in Indian kitchens, has launched its "TUP Celebration Glassware" for Diwali. This new product line is available exclusively through Instamart. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: RBI Opens Dollar Window for Oil Firms Amidst Rupee Pressure
item.description: The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) has established a special window for oil companies to purchase dollars, aiming to alleviate pressure on the Indian rupee. This measure is part of a two-pronged strategy by the RBI to support the rupee, which… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Vivo V80 Smartphone Review and Comparison
item.description: Reviews of the Vivo V80 smartphone highlight its camera capabilities, while also questioning its price point. Comparisons have been made between the Vivo V80 and the OPPO Reno 16, examining aspects such as battery life, display quality… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Analysis of Silver's Long-Term Growth Potential for Gen Z
item.description: This analysis explores the long-term growth potential of silver as an investment, specifically targeting Generation Z. It posits that silver could be considered the 'new gold' and highlights the importance of correctly pricing water… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.title: Oil Prices Surge Above $104 Amid Hormuz Attacks and Hurricane Fears
item.description: Global oil prices have surpassed $104 per barrel, driven by concerns over supply disruptions. Attacks on tankers in the Strait of Hormuz have reached a "wartime high," with Iran reportedly attempting to restrict oil exports. Concurrently… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 4 · Right 0.

item.title: Coal Supplies to Power Plants Increase Significantly
item.description: Coal supplies to power plants have risen by 36% from their September low point, with daily rail loading reaching 465 rakes. The Coal Ministry indicated that stock depletion and power demand are expected to moderate by mid-October, citing… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Jio Platforms and Airtel Money Pursue Major Listings
item.description: Jio Platforms is reportedly being considered for an Initial Public Offering (IPO) at a valuation of approximately ₹11 lakh crore, which would place it slightly above Airtel's current market capitalization of around ₹10.87 lakh crore… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.title: Trump announces deal for Russian diesel to enter US and global markets
item.description: U.S. President Donald Trump announced a deal following talks with Russian President Vladimir Putin for Russia to supply nearly 5 million tons of diesel fuel to the United States and global markets. The agreement aims to lower fuel prices… Coverage: Left 5 · Centre 28 · Right 6.

item.title: Poonawalla Fincorp Reports Five-Fold Profit Surge in Q2
item.description: Poonawalla Fincorp announced a net profit of ₹375 crore for the second quarter, a five-fold increase year-on-year. The company's net interest income rose by 75.6% due to loan portfolio expansion. New disbursements accounted for 28% of the… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 6 · Right 0.

item.title: Shell takes stake in Equinor's Canadian oil project
item.description: Shell has agreed to acquire a 30% stake in Equinor's Bay du Nord oil project located in Canada. The project is situated off the coast of Newfoundland and Labrador. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Alaska Fish Fight Over Trawling Fuels Consumer Concern
item.description: A dispute over trawling practices in Alaska is drawing attention to the origin of fish used in American fish sticks. The conflict centers on how fish are caught and processed, impacting the supply chain for consumer products. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Businesses protest government surcharge ban
item.description: Businesses in Sydney are protesting a government ban on surcharges, with some stating that 'cash is king'. The ban, which has drawn criticism from businesses, is the subject of ongoing debate. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: GSK to invest $800 million in Pennsylvania biopharma hub
item.description: GlaxoSmithKline (GSK) plans to invest over $800 million to expand its biopharmaceutical hub in Pennsylvania, a move expected to create 300 jobs. The company's investment will focus on enhancing its biopharma capabilities within the state. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Andhra Pradesh and MP Announce Investment Drives for Job Creation
item.description: Andhra Pradesh's Minister Bharath announced an investment drive targeting the Orvakal industrial hub, aiming to attract ₹50,000 crore and create 45,000 jobs. Separately, Madhya Pradesh has reportedly drawn ₹90,000 crore in investment… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Flipkart Big Billion Days Sees 6.3 Million Concurrent Users
item.description: Flipkart's Big Billion Days sale event commenced with 6.3 million concurrent users accessing the platform. The figure represents the number of users simultaneously present on Flipkart during the sale's opening. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.
